## Bug fixed: `click.echo` / pager crash when no std streams attached

### Reproduction (before fix)
`/tmp/repro.py` with `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` set to `None`:
```
stdout: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'
stderr: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'
bytes stdout: AttributeError: ...
pager: AttributeError: ...
```
Cause: `_make_cached_stream_func` wrapped `None` into a text stream (`_force_correct_text_writer(None, ...)` returns `None`), so `echo`/`pager` got `None` back and called `.write`/`.flush` on it.

### Exact diff applied
```

-) -> t.Callable[[], t.TextIO]:
